facts.fact: 新春芽亭的屋顶被整个拆掉了。
facts.anchor: The roof of the Pavilion of Spring Buds had been removed entirely.

facts.fact: Merlin 那棵树被修剪成许愿树，人们往枝上挂纸条。
facts.anchor: A wishing tree had been born.

facts.fact: Madam Yau 端着茶问那个苍白洋人是不是影兽。
facts.anchor: “So, that pasty gweilo, he’s the shadow beast?” Madam Yau said.

facts.fact: 她追问那是不是她一直来往、把消息分给他的那个人。
facts.anchor: “The one you’ve spent all your time with? The one you shared your information with?”

facts.fact: Hoi 嘴上说谁都会犯错，脸上却带着乐。
facts.anchor: “We’ve all made mistakes.” Hoi gor may have used magnanimous words

facts.fact: Kiamling 心里断定 Archie 其实想被抓住。
facts.anchor: Archie had wanted to be caught.

facts.fact: 她把 Beggar So 在广州给她的金属球放到桌上。
facts.anchor: She placed the wan yi on the table, the metal sphere Beggar So had given her in Canton.

facts.fact: 她说敌人不知道新年之交两界帷幕会变薄。
facts.anchor: They do not know that the veil between the worlds thins at the start of the new year.

facts.fact: 她从树上折下一根细枝做演示。
facts.anchor: Kiamling snapped a thin branch from the tree.

facts.fact: 那根枝上一头樱花、门口秋色、顶端花苞，四季同时。
facts.anchor: All the seasons in one place and time.

facts.fact: 她用发簪扎穿三朵花与影子的中心。
facts.anchor: A hole pierced the centre of the shadow, all three flowers skewered by a hairpin Kiamling had stabbed through them.

facts.fact: 她说年关恐怕是唯一能纠正这件事的机会。
facts.anchor: the only chance to put this right

facts.fact: 广州的猎妖人连见都不肯见她们。
facts.anchor: “They refused to even meet with us.”

facts.fact: Madam Yau 说她们从来不是孤身一人。
facts.anchor: “Never alone,” Madam Yau agreed.

facts.fact: 她想人不是凭空长成的。
facts.anchor: People did not grow in a void.

facts.fact: 她还要等量的糯米和盐。
facts.anchor: Also glutinous rice and salt, mixed in equal quantities.

facts.fact: 她把招魂的活派给妹妹。
facts.anchor: “Mui mui, how would you like to speak to a dead priest?”

facts.fact: Nairns 牧师平静地确认自己已经死了。
facts.anchor: “So, I’m dead.”

facts.fact: 牧师说 Archie 生来就带着魔鬼的印记。
facts.anchor: He had the Devil’s mark on him from the day he was born.

facts.fact: 牧师讲到墓地的死人站了起来。
facts.anchor: the dead rose from my graveyard

facts.fact: 她决定先去找那位忠实的朋友。
facts.anchor: “First, we talk to our devoted friend.”
